description: This file defines the RouteParser class for the Slim Framework, implementing URL route parsing and URL generation methods, including relative, absolute, and full URL construction based on route names and data.

classes.name: RouteParser
classes.description: Implements route parsing and URL generation for the Slim Framework, handling relative, absolute, and full URL creation based on route names and data.

methods.name: relativeUrlFor
methods.description: Generates a relative URL for a named route using provided data and query parameters.

methods.name: urlFor
methods.description: Generates a full URL for a named route, including base path, using provided data and query parameters.

methods.name: fullUrlFor
methods.description: Constructs a complete URL including scheme, authority, and path for a named route based on a given URI object.
